name: SIM management create and list operations
description: A manager can create a new SIM card entry and see it appear in the SIMs list with the correct details.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the login page and log in as manager
Navigate to the SIMs management page
Click the Add New SIM or Create button
Enter a valid ICCID number in the ICCID field
Select a provider from the provider dropdown
Enter a phone number in the phone number field
Click the Save or Submit button
Verify the SIM is created successfully and appears in the SIMs list with the entered ICCID and provider
